passages.title: Organising a Surprise Party
passages.text: Organising a surprise party for a friend can be a lot of fun, but it requires careful planning. First, you need to decide on a date and time that work for everyone. It is essential to keep the plan a secret, so make sure you do not tell the person (1) ______ birthday it is! You might want to create a group chat online, but be careful (2) ______ you add to it. Ask everyone to arrive at the venue at least thirty minutes before the guest of honour. This ensures that everyone is hidden (3) ______ the person arrives. You should also think about the food and drinks. A buffet is usually the best option (4) ______ it allows people to move around and talk to each other easily. Don't forget to decorate the room with balloons and banners to make it look special. Finally, when the person walks in, remember to shout 'Surprise!' as loudly as you can. It is a moment (5) ______ they will definitely remember for a long time. If you follow these simple steps, your surprise party (6) ______ be a huge success.

questions.question: Gap 1
questions.explanation: The relative pronoun 'whose' is used to show possession.

questions.question: Gap 2
questions.explanation: The relative pronoun 'who' refers to the people being added to the chat.

questions.question: Gap 3
questions.explanation: The conjunction 'before' indicates the time preceding the arrival.

questions.question: Gap 4
questions.explanation: The conjunction 'because' introduces the reason for choosing a buffet.

questions.question: Gap 5
questions.explanation: The relative pronoun 'that' refers back to the moment.

questions.question: Gap 6
questions.explanation: The modal verb 'will' is used to express a future prediction.
